claims.text: Other topical choices: gentamicin, or a topical fluoroquinolone if Pseudomonas is suspected. Neomycin-containing products are discouraged (allergic reaction in approximately 10%)
claims.quote: Topical antibiotics for paronychia include mupirocin (Bactroban), gentamicin, or a topical fluoroquinolone if pseudomonal infection is suspected. Neomycin-containing compounds are discouraged because of the risk of allergic reaction (approximately 10%).
